summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Lease Abstraction Assistant MVP. 15/15 pytest backend tests pass (health, list, stats, get, upload via real PDF + Gemini, draft, approve, approved-edit-block, CSV export 14 cols, empty-export 404 message, approved count). Playwright frontend smoke covered Dashboard (stats 6/6/3/2, dropzone, recent uploads), History (6 rows with metadata & status & method & quality), Review page (4 sections, 10 field inputs, summary, warning banner, needs-review panel with all 10 missing for failed doc, save-draft flash 'Draft saved.', read-only when approved verified via API), and Export Data page ('2 approved records ready for export.' + active Download CSV). All flows work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: GET /api/documents/{id} returns 400 for malformed ObjectId — UX nicer than 404 but inconsistent with REST norms (404 also acceptable). Not blocking.
Minor: Export Data page label 'Checking approved records…' is the loading state; consider a skeleton/spinner instead of text-only fade for clarity (took ~2s on first paint).
Code: routes/upload.py re-imports bson.ObjectId inside the handler; minor but could be moved to module top-level.
Code: serializers.py drops `_id` correctly via `id = str(_id)` — good, no ObjectId leakage.
Code: processing/extraction modular and OCR fallback handles tesseract-missing case; failed PDFs still create a record marked extraction_method=failed which is correct for the spec.
Spec adherence: CSV has exactly 14 columns as required; build_csv only iterates docs passed in, and the route filters status=='approved' — correct.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /app/backend/seed.py (6 documents: 2 approved, 3 needs_review, 1 processed). Re-ran seed.py at the end of testing to restore any mutations made during draft/approve UI testing. Final state verified: total=6, processed=6, needs_review=3, approved=2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (15 tests, ~7s runtime, includes a real Gemini extraction call via reportlab-generated PDF). Empty-export test toggles approved docs to needs_review in mongo and restores them in finally block — safe. Uploaded TEST_*.pdf docs are cleaned up by session-scope autouse fixture. To rerun: cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. If seed ever wiped, restore via: cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python seed.py.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial Playwright pass observed History showing only 1 row and Export label still 'Checking approved records…' — that was a test-timing issue (page hadn't finished its initial fetch). After adding ~2.5s wait, History rendered all 6 rows and Export showed '2 approved records ready for export.' correctly. Not a product bug.
